label: Metaphysical admissibility in the…: The Bool metaphysical frame admits v from w exactly when v = w
term: metaphysical admissibility in the two-description control
definition: The Bool metaphysical frame admits v from w exactly when v = w. This is a stipulated stronger admissibility profile on candidate descriptions, not an assertion that real metaphysical possibility is identity accessibility.
note: Its philosophical adequacy remains open. The control only refutes unrestricted E-to-M transfer without inclusion.
